runtimeConditions.anon_closed: For each of the three tables verify anon and relevant non-bypass roles inheriting anon have no effective SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER/MAINTAIN authority, including PUBLIC, inherited and column grants; no ownership/BYPASSRLS escape. Closed direct ACLs alone do not prove this. Preserve designed server/RPC public surfaces.
runtimeConditions.exact_full_gate: Bind the same immutable reference, selected sources, forward receipts, full catalog and role graph; no row-hash allowlist, snapshot refresh, policy pruning or equality bypass. Independently verify all unreviewed schema/function/ACL/type requirements before schema acceptance.
runtimeConditions.info_event_widening: Ordinary authenticated SELECT uses tenant read guard; INSERT/UPDATE use tenant write guard; ordinary authenticated and authenticated-platform DELETE are denied by service predicate. Validate raw same-company payload/event visibility explicitly, not merely the narrower service-backed UI DTO. Preserve actual service authority under the qualified role graph.
runtimeConditions.invitation_canonical: Require effective authenticated INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE denial, including authenticated platform users, column/PUBLIC/inherited grants and owner authority; actual direct writes must fail 42501. Preserve SELECT and authorized canonical definer/service invitation operations. The two replacement predicates remain hash-only and are accepted as inert only under this verified capability boundary.
runtimeConditions.role_graph: Qualify actual role attributes, ownership/FORCE RLS, inherited/PUBLIC and column privileges. The compiler expanded PUBLIC into a finite role inventory; authenticated replacement hashes do not prove all-role equivalence. For service authority inspect actual BYPASSRLS/superuser status and any non-bypass roles inheriting service applicability.
runtimeConditions.send_lock_remediation: Before accepting lock-table capabilities, qualify the separate narrow forward revocation of authenticated non-SELECT table privileges, including residual column/PUBLIC/inherited and owner authority. Direct authenticated/platform INSERT/UPDATE must fail 42501; preserve read policies, existing rows, service writes and authorized service-only canonical/restoration definer RPCs; require authenticated/anon EXECUTE denial on the final restore RPC. Verify atomic failure and repeat behavior. Do not claim a delivered-message exploit or a new replay regression.
runtimeConditions.tenant_read: Using retained helpers and SET ROLE authenticated, evaluate all applicable permissive OR/restrictive AND branches: allowed member/operations/admin reads own active/onboarding/paused companies, not other/NULL or hidden companies; disabled session and inactive membership denied; allowed platform reads include NULL-company rows. Include a second legitimate membership.
runtimeConditions.tenant_write: For INSERT check and each UPDATE USING/WITH CHECK independently require the retained write helper: allowed operations/owner/admin/company_admin and allowed platform on active/onboarding companies; member-only, wrong company, NULL company, paused/hidden company, disabled session and inactive membership denied. Test old/new-company cross-products separately and preserve required SELECT behavior. Hash reconstruction is not actual DML/trigger/business-graph qualification.
runtimeConditions.user_role_widening: Include same-company non-self user_roles rows and NULL-company platform rows; preserve actor-bound platform-management checks and direct authenticated user_roles DML denial. Tenant role-row visibility does not grant the caller platform authority.

anon_cleanup.purpose: F-14 second sweep drops non-PUBLIC-role policies when their named roles lack effective table SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE authority; includes restrictive anon guards.

compiler.purpose: Finite-role expansion of PUBLIC permissive policies; command-specific OR composition and old-name removal.

db1_original.purpose: Explicit PUBLIC tenant SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE for the DB1 table list.

db1_repair.purpose: Repeated named DB1 table-list tenant policies; DELETE is separately platform-scoped.

introspection.purpose: Canonical policy row fields and expression rendering.

lifecycle.purpose: Read/write helpers and restrictive guards; canonical-only direct access-management DML revocation.

linter_self_and_anon.purpose: user_roles self-read and later REVOKE ALL from PUBLIC/anon on all public tables.

lock_app.purpose: Platform action invokes canonical pause; direct unlock is refused.

lock_canonical_authorization.purpose: Unchecked function revoked; authorized wrapper service-only.

lock_canonical_projection.purpose: Canonical transition owns lock projection writes; original function service-only.

lock_convergence.purpose: BEFORE trigger normalizes locked to status without checking actor authority.

lock_final_transition.purpose: Final canonical actor permission, idempotency and readiness checks.

lock_platform_original.purpose: Original explicit platform-only lock INSERT/UPDATE policy intent.

lock_requeue.purpose: AFTER trigger can requeue matching blocked unsent rows when canonical state is live; no proven message delivery claim.

lock_restore_final_acl.purpose: Final restore RPC execution is service-only; PUBLIC/anon/authenticated revoked.

lock_restore_hotfix.purpose: UUID aggregate hotfix establishes final restore body; immutable reference retains the resulting definition.

lock_restore_rpc.purpose: Original platform-gated SECURITY DEFINER restoration RPC; its initial authenticated grant is later revoked by lock_restore_final_acl.

lock_tenant_legacy.purpose: Later explicit generic tenant write policy includes ediel_send_locks; broad direct authorization predates replay.

platform_helper.purpose: Actor-bound platform authority and helper privileges.

session_helper.purpose: Actor session allowance is profile/status based; not an auth.sessions token-revocation proof.

tenant_batch2b.purpose: Explicit company-scoped reads and writes, including user_roles and customer_info_request_events.

tenant_debug2.purpose: Explicit direct tenant SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE intent, including customer_info_request_events; no DELETE grant/policy added by this loop.

true_reads.purpose: Guarded authenticated TRUE-read substitution and statement-level lifecycle SELECT expression.
